current_architecture.paper_reference: Section 3 and Figure 2 category-conditioned RoboTHOR ObjectNav; NOT Figure 5 zero-shot model
current_architecture.visual_encoder: Frozen CLIP RN50, 2048x7x7 features; no attention pooling
current_architecture.goal: learned 32-dimensional embedding of one of 12 target category IDs, not CLIP text
current_architecture.shared_goal_visual_encoder: convolutional compression and goal combination, flattened 1568-dimensional recurrent input
current_architecture.variant: single-layer GaWF1160, previous detached raw policy logits as feedback; feedback reset at episode boundary
current_architecture.heads: same linear actor and critic design, input dimensions change from 512 to 1160
current_architecture.parameter_match_scope: all trainable policy parameters; frozen CLIP preprocessor excluded
current_architecture.shared_pair_protocol: RGB + category, same CLIP normalization, goal encoder architecture, PPO configuration, training scene pool, evaluation episodes, budget, and step limit
current_architecture.light_training: 5M frame budget, 16 parallel training environments, 128 rollout, 500 step limit; this is not the paper 200M training protocol
current_architecture.simulator: AI2-THOR 5.0.0; not claimed equivalent to historical paper build

tables.current_pair: Our common-validation SR/SPL can already be compared. These are validation results of light retraining, not paper test leaderboard values. tables.current_pair: Our RGB-only fixed-g0 DD-PPO pair can have its own validation table. It cannot reproduce this table: original uses ideal online GPS+Compass and CLIP/ImageNet encoder comparison, unlike current RGB-only fixed-g0 ResNet18 protocol.

tables.topic: Frozen visual-feature linear probes: object presence, localization, free space, reachability
tables.current_pair: The two agents use the same frozen CLIP backbone. Applying identical original probes to that same backbone does not test GRU versus GaWF. A recurrent-memory probe would be a newly defined experiment, requiring aligned histories, held-out labels and trained probes.

tables.topic: Zero-shot RoboTHOR ObjectNav, 8 seen / 4 unseen target categories
tables.current_pair: Requires Figure 5 text-goal architecture and new paired training restricted to 8 categories, evaluating 4 held-out categories. Current learned-category checkpoints trained on all 12 classes do not support this claim.
